CCM 1.0.0-beta.1 is the first public beta of the Code Counter Machine.

Count source, follow a declared change, and inspect the evidence and resource assumptions behind the result. The release includes terminal, standalone HTML, JSON, NDJSON, and CSV reports, a broad language catalog, and an editable 2026 AI, tool, and human cost scenario.

Downloads include Linux x86-64 and ARM64 (static musl), Windows x86-64 (static MSVC runtime), macOS Intel and Apple Silicon (macOS 12+), and FreeBSD x86-64 (15.1). Each archive contains the executable, licenses, and a build record naming its exact source commit. SHA256SUMS covers all six archives and the PDF book.

macOS binaries are unsigned. This is a beta interface; the economic model is a planning scenario with unverified workload assumptions, not measured usage or a validated delivery forecast.

Website and book: https://insanai.github.io/ccm/
Corresponding source and build instructions: https://github.com/insanai/ccm/tree/v1.0.0-beta.1
License: LGPL-3.0-or-later; bundled language metadata retains its MIT notice.
